Results.ReviewText:
Great grill! Love the flavor, love the ease of use! However, why is the thermometer located where it is? On some grills, their are either two thermometers or the thermometer is located over the actual cooking area. 
This grill took about 10 minutes to set up. It was super easy to set up!
The taste is amazing! I like my other wood grill, but for a quick hot cook, I prefer this grill.
Results.Title: Perfect grill! Great update from my dad's grill!`

Results.ReviewText: I am 75 years old and have been using Weber grills for probably 2/3 of my life. I have owned and used the hell out of the many different grills and smokers that I’ve had. Every time I get a new one it just seems to be at least a little better than the previous one and this new one is no exception. I’ve only used it twice so far but it definitely hits the sweet spot. I have owned WSMs since Christmas of 1984 so I haven’t owned a full size kettle grill in a long time. I have owned all 3 sizes of the smokers and have loved them all. I am currently down to the 14.5” since my wife and I don’t eat nearly as much as we used to. This 22” kettle will, in all likelihood, be my last grill purchase. I intend to use it and love it for the rest of my days.
Results.Title: Thank you Weber !!

Results.ReviewText: Simple good quality BBQ. Perfect size for family dinners and the ash catcher is a must have. I suggest Lump charcoal for the best flavor. We had gas for years and it just wasnt putting out what i wanted. Best purchase of the season.
Results.Title: Love my Kettle

Results.ReviewText: This grill gets great reviews for a reason. The air controls provide excellent control of grill temperature and some modern improvements kick it up a notch from there. The hinged cooking grate allows you to easily add more charcoal during cooking (optional charcoal baskets recommended) and the ash  bin makes ash management a simple, rather than tedious task. If you like charcoal grilling, this is as good as it gets. The added bonus is durability, so you'll be grilling with greatness for a very long time to come.
Results.Title: Classic Grilling With a Modern Touch

Results.ReviewText: Easy to assemble, with videos that solved any open questions. A classic beautiful object that grills a perfectly flavored meal. The cover fits well and hopefully will hold up more than the 3-4 years advertised.

Results.ReviewText: Well my boyfriend is the cook of the house because i am bedbound. He grills every night! Everything you could imagine on it! He grills his turkey on there and omg it is delicious!!! Everything he cooks is delicious and perfect for how i like my food. The temperature gauge is awesome! He cooks mine to a certain degrees ( i like mine medium rare) takes mine off and lets his finish cooking. It is healthy, that is what i have to have being sick like i am. No grease,  just amazing spices and the grill taste everybody loves! Heats up so fast and cooks so fast but not burnt. I have ordered the griddle, cover, utensils, all the good things that a grill needs!! Im so glad hr wanted this one after all. I honestly thought the price was ridiculous because i thought it was a regular grill. I WAS WRONG!! You definitely get your money worth and so much more. He couldnt have picked a better one out there!!!
Results.Title: YOU DEFINITELY GET YOUR MONEY'S WORTH AND MORE!!

Results.ReviewText: Great color!!  However, not anything like my old weber premium kettle of which I had for 10 years.  Instructions for assembly was quite easy.  My first cook wasn't what I expected.  The lid slides around the base quite freely and appears to not have a great seal.  (MORE ON THAT SHORTLY). The vent on the lid does not have a rubber handle like my last one making it difficult to adjust without a pot holder.  Venting apparatus oil the base lacks a good seal with the three vents at the bottom making it difficult to adjust temperature.  Also, my last premium Weber kettle grill had an outside rack of which you could slide or rest the lid into without having to hang it on the side.  Lastly, the venting on the bottom is supposed to assist with smothering the coals at the end of the cook making them reusable for the next cook.  There vents allowed air in and when I opened the lid a few hours later all the charcoal had burned away leaving nothing but ashes.  So...I'm not to pleased with my purchase and discouraged as to how the quality of this reputable grill has declined.  Thanks for the opportunity to allow a review.
Results.Title: Quality Has Declined

Results.ReviewText: Love the Smokey flavour it gives the meat. The more we use it, the easier the whole experience is.
Results.Title: One steps leads to the next.

Results.ReviewText: Love the grill overall with one exception. Need a handle on both sides of the grill.  At times, I need to move the grill quickly due to weather conditions. I prefer to pick up the grill instead of rolling it on its wheels.
Results.Title: Need handles on both sides of grill

Results.ReviewText: Great grill. Heat management is simple. Exceeds expectations. Highly recommend.

Results.ReviewText: A timeless classic. Reliable, sturdy. You can sear, smoke and cook just about anything.
Results.Title: King of all Charcoal grills.

14401001.Name: 22” Original Kettle® Premium Charcoal Grill
14401001.Description: Some things never go out of style—like the smoky flavor of charcoal, the sizzle of a summer cookout, and the iconic silhouette of the 22" Original Kettle® Premium Charcoal Grill. This grill features a built-in lid thermometer to monitor the temperature inside the grill, and a hinged, plated-steel cooking grate flips up on either side allowing you to easily add more fuel while cooking. Like all Weber® kettles, it’s built to last with a porcelain-enameled bowl and lid that retains heat and resist rust, peeling, and scratching, and adjustable lid and bowl dampers to fine-tune the heat for perfect results. When it’s time to clean up, the One-Touch™ cleaning system makes it neat and effortless—just swipe the lever to clear ashes into the enclosed, high-capacity ash catcher. Two wheels make it easy to roll this timeless classic to the center of the action, right where it belongs. Because some grills don’t just cook food, they make memories.· Porcelain-enameled finish is scratch and rust-resistant· Room to cook for 6-8 people· Hinged, plated-steel cooking grate· Lid thermometer makes it easy to see grill temperature· Adjustable lid and bowl dampers let you control temperature· Lid hook to hang lid on bowl while cooking· 2 tool hooks included on bowl handle· One-Touch™ cleaning system sweeps ash into enclosed catcher· Easy to move on two durable, all-weather wheels· Heat-resistant lid and bowl handles· Bottom, wire storage shelf· Durable fuel grate· 3 aluminum legs are rust-resistant· 10-year limited warranty
